closed_gaps.summary: Removed PRIME-DB-as-enterprise-authority wording and restored OVID/THESEUS ownership.
Separated shipped mining substrate from planned enterprise services.
Locked refuted transfer-note hypotheses as non-promotable claims.
Chronos v3.3 compatibility facade, package data and executable capability audit were merged.
Transfer notes reflected in the repository in their entirety.
OVID is the durable folded-state root; THESEUS is rebuildable from OVID and can be deleted without data loss.
Chronus is ONE iGPU. device_count!=1 fails closed. Storage correctness does not require a Chronus device.
